resume: A grant for families with at least 3 children who move around the time of a birth: date conditions, maximum amounts, documents to send and the 6-month deadline.
aQuoiCaSert: The moving grant (prime de déménagement) from the Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office) reimburses actual moving costs, up to a maximum amount, for families with at least 3 children who move during the pregnancy of their 3rd or later child, or within two years of the youngest child's birth. It is paid in one go, on proof of costs. An advance based on a quote is possible if your situation is precarious.
quiEstConcerne: Families with at least 3 dependent children, born or expected.
Who are entitled, for the new home, to the APL (aide personnalisée au logement, personalized housing aid) or the ALF (allocation de logement familiale, family housing allowance).
Separated parent: these conditions are assessed for your own Caf household.
aSavoir: Dates: the move must take place between the 1st day of the month following the end of the 3rd month of pregnancy and the last day of the month before the youngest child's 2nd birthday.
Maximum amounts since April 1, 2026: €1,147.58 for 3 children, €1,243.21 for 4 children, plus €95.63 per additional child. You are reimbursed your actual costs up to this limit.
Advance if your situation is precarious: 50% to 75% of the quote, up to the amount of the grant due. The paid invoice must then be sent within 6 months of the move.
Apply to the Caf of your new place of residence, no later than 6 months after the move.
If refused, you have 2 months from the decision to refer the matter to the Caf's amicable appeals board (commission de recours amiable).
